target_customer: Crypto institutions, hedge funds, DeFi protocols and retail traders wanting on-chain options and derivatives
problem: Derivatives trading has many intermediaries and crypto derivatives are centralized; EthosX aims to run the full derivatives lifecycle on-chain without exchanges or clearing banks.
business_model: Protocol and trading platform fees on options and perpetual options (OPerps), institutional OTC platform and infrastructure for other crypto companies

founders.name: Deepanshu
prior_employers: JP Morgan Chase (VP, Quantitative Research, Global Derivatives Clearing)
founders.background_notes: From YC company page. Single name as listed there.

founders.name: Smit Patoliya
prior_employers: Unnamed quantitative hedge fund trading options
founders.background_notes: From YC company page and launch post.

competitors.name: Lyra
competitors.what: On-chain options AMM for European options on Optimism

competitors.name: Ribbon Finance
competitors.what: Structured product vaults for options built on Opyn
competitors.traction_then: Among the largest on-chain options protocols by TVL in 2022
competitors.funding_then: $8.75M round led by Paradigm in March 2022, plus a $6M round in 2021 per a search summary

technical_complexity.rationale: On-chain options pricing, collateral, liquidation and clearing with smart contract security; options AMMs had repeatedly struggled.

defensibility.rationale: Open smart contracts are forkable; moat depends on liquidity and institutional relationships, and sector TVL fell about 81% in 2022 per a search summary.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; centralized and DeFi options venues competed throughout.

market_need_then: Crypto options volume was concentrated on centralized venues and on-chain options had small TVL; the founders cite centralization risk after 2022 failures.

branding.domain_note: Uses ethosx.finance, not a .com; a search result mentions ethosx.xyz.
branding.community_and_virality: Airdrop and early access campaigns on the site; no organic community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand coverage beyond sponsored press releases; OPerps is a distinctive product name but traction was limited.

outcome_analysis: EthosX entered YC in Summer 2022 with an on-chain derivatives protocol during a crypto bear market. It raised a reported $1.8M in December 2023 and launched perpetual options (OPerps) in 2024, but a search summary showed zero TVL on DeFiLlama at the time of the snapshot. The company is listed active; no exit or shutdown found, and traction looks limited.
notes: The $1.8M round comes from a Chainwire sponsored press release on Decrypt (company claim); TechFlow lists YC, Franklin Templeton and Emurgo as participants, a second outlet seen in a snippet only. Round stage not stated so 'other'. Total raised conflicts: CB Insights about $2.3M over four rounds, AlphaGrowth $4.1M; unverified. Earlier YC deal not recorded. Competitor sources: Ribbon round is about nine months after the batch start in March 2022 coverage (within batch year, before Summer 2022 start, so before it). YC launch post names no competitors; Lyra and Ribbon chosen from dated funding news. DeFiLlama TVL snapshot and the OPerps 2024 launch come from search summaries (yespress.io unreliable). Founders have single-name listing for Deepanshu on YC.
